messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to update the triage checklist and assign owners for remediation items from yesterday's outage. Can we agree owners + deadlines in this thread?
Daniel: I'll take owner for the cache-eviction fallback changes and document rollback steps. Target: end of week.
Eli: I'll own the hot-restart script and GPU diagnostic snippets; will add exact `kubectl` commands and example outputs to the playbook.
SRE Bot: Incident summary: shard-grouper memory leak -> several GPUs saturated -> automatic failover triggered. Logs attached in the incident doc.
Priya: Noted recurring pattern: spikes in batch-merging + long tail cause backlog growth. We should add an early check for `batch-queue` backlog to the triage steps.
Daniel: Proposed triage checklist snippet (for inclusion in playbook):
```
1) Check lane health: `curl -s http://status/internal/lanes | jq .`
2) Check batch-queue length: `redis-cli -h redis-service LLEN batch-queue`
3) If queue > 1000, flip ingestion throttle: `POST https://admin.internal/api/throttle`
4) Run hot-restart (graceful): `./scripts/hot_restart.sh --graceful`
5) Confirm KV cache usage: `redis-cli INFO memory`
6) GPU mem quick-check: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv`
```
Maya: @Eli can you paste the exact `kubectl` commands you'll include for rollouts and pod diagnostics?
Eli: Will add these:
```
# check pods in inference namespace
kubectl get pods -n inference-prod -o wide
# describe noisy pod
kubectl describe pod <pod-name> -n inference-prod
# fetch logs for container
kubectl logs <pod-name> -c transformer -n inference-prod --since=15m
# rollout undo if necessary
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service -n inference-prod --to-revision=<rev>
```
Eli: also add `ps aux | grep inference` and `du -sh /var/lib/inference/cache` to catch runaway processes or disk growth.
Sam: I'll pair with @Daniel and open the playbook PR with formatting + examples. ETA Tue EOD.
Priya: Escalation path suggestion: if host GPU memory > 85% for > 5m -> page on-call SRE; if persists > 15m -> page senior infra and exec bridge. Add explicit phone + slack steps and who to cc.
Maya: Agree. Also add a step to verify fallback model route and the safe-fallback toggle (how to check and flip).
Daniel: I'll open the PR with checklist + owners list and add 'who to cc' for rate-limits: `@growth`, `@support`.
Maya: Assigning owners summary for the action tracker:
- Daniel: cache-eviction fallback + rollback steps (due Fri)
- Eli: hot-restart + GPU diagnostics (due Tue)
- Sam: playbook PR + formatting (due Tue)
- Priya: escalation timings + phone numbers (due Thu)
Maya: I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 9am PT for SRE + Product to walk the new checklist :calendar: .
Eli: tiny nit — include explicit `--namespace=inference-prod` in all `kubectl` examples and example `KUBECONFIG` contexts so less chance of running against staging.
Sam: noted, will add.
Maya: please paste PR links here as you open them so we can track in the action tracker. :thumbsup:
SRE Bot: Created Jira task INF-4578 for follow-ups with reminders 3 days before each due date.
Daniel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-playbooks/pull/412
Eli: Draft PR in progress, will ping when ready.
Priya: Escalation doc PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ops-docs/pull/88
Maya: closing the thread for async updates — we'll keep tracking in Jira and the action tracker. If anything slips, we can reopen here. Thanks all.
